china-1931-2:p0399_2.rationale: Pilotage tariff for steamers by draught at Whampoa/Canton harbour: charges for port services.

china-1931-2:p0399_3.rationale: Additional pilotage charges above Whampoa and berth-shifting fee at the Canton anchorage; port service charges.

china-1931-2:p0401_1.rationale: Drainage areas of Yangtze watershed districts in square miles, with total.

china-1931-2:p0402_1.rationale: Monthly rainfall June-August 1931 at cities across the Yangtze watershed, given as background to the flood. Weather observations are the substantive content.

china-1931-2:p0402_2.rationale: Yearly maximum and minimum Yangtze water levels at Hankow, 1868-1931, to measure the 1931 flood against; a river water-regime description.

china-1931-2:p0405_1.rationale: Maximum flood heights and crest dates of the Yangtze and tributaries in 1931 at various places.

china-1931-2:p0407_1.rationale: Cash and in-kind emergency and winter relief by the National Flood Relief Commission up to 31 Dec 1931.

china-1931-2:p0411_1.rationale: Annual output of one-cent copper coins 1904-1908; coinage issuance is a monetary subject rather than copper mining.

china-1931-2:p0412_1.rationale: Shanghai year-end rate of copper cents per dollar 1912-1931, a conversion between monetary units showing depreciation.

china-1931-2:p0412_2.rationale: Percentage loss on converting copper cents to dollars in Shanghai Tramways accounts; the monetary conversion loss is the main subject, with a tramway company as the context. No tram operating data are presented, so the trams tag is not assigned.
